description: This Java source file defines the MainActivity class for an Android application using fragment management to set up a card stream interface with retention capabilities. It manages fragment transactions, implements click listener interface, and handles state persistence for the card stream.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: An Android Activity that manages a fragment-based UI consisting of a CardStream and retention fragment, handling their lifecycle and state.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up fragments, and enforces that BatchStepSensorFragment implements OnCardClickListener.

methods.name: getCardStream
methods.description: Retrieves or initializes the CardStreamFragment associated with this activity.

methods.name: onSaveInstanceState
methods.description: Saves the current state of the CardStream into the retention fragment for persistence across configuration changes.
